capabilities.name: artifacts.activities
capabilities.title: List the lab's activities
capabilities.description: Activities (sessions and runs) in the lab's store, newest commit first, with end status, each run's parent activity and code name, and the inputs each run recorded (role, target artifact, digest): the edges for walking an artifact's lineage. One page per call; repeat with the returned next cursor until it is empty.

status.description: end status; empty while still running

startedAt.description: activity start time; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

endedAt.description: activity end time; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

seq.description: lineage-journal sequence that wrote the activity

parent.description: parent activity id (a run's session); empty at top level

code.description: code that ran, e.g. apk.search-strings; empty for sessions

role.description: input role in the run, e.g. package

target.description: full input target ref, e.g. artifact:<id> or content:<digest>

artifact.description: input artifact id; empty for content-only targets

inputs.description: the run's recorded inputs, in recorded order; empty for sessions and input-less runs

activities.description: one page of the lab's activities, newest commit first

next.description: cursor for the next page; empty on the last

capabilities.name: artifacts.checkpoints.list
capabilities.title: List the lab's checkpoints
capabilities.description: The lab's timeline of observed events (an import) and attributed agent turn accounts, oldest first. Artifact references were checked against the lab's store when written; an agent's account is its interpretation, not a finding. Page with the next cursor.

checkpoints.description: one page of the lab's timeline, oldest first

enabled.description: whether the lab is recording checkpoints

capabilities.name: artifacts.checkpoints.record
capabilities.title: Record an agent's account of a turn
capabilities.description: For the subsystem that runs an agent's turns: add the agent's account of a turn to the lab's timeline, with every cited artifact checked against the lab's store, or with missing the fact that a turn ended without one. Does nothing while the lab has checkpoints turned off. Not an agent tool.

agent.description: the agent whose turn this is; empty with missing

text.description: the agent's account of the turn, 1 to 8000 characters

artifactIds.description: artifacts the account cites; each must be in the lab, at most 32

missing.description: the turn ended with no usable account: record the gap instead

recorded.description: false when the lab has checkpoints turned off

capabilities.name: artifacts.checkpoints.set
capabilities.title: Turn the lab's checkpoints on or off
capabilities.description: Turn recording of checkpoints on or off for this lab. Entries already in the timeline stay.

enabled.description: record imports and agent turn accounts in this lab's timeline

capabilities.name: artifacts.claims
capabilities.title: List the lab's claims
capabilities.description: Claims in the lab's store, newest commit first: kind, target, stored JSON value and producing activity. One page per call; repeat with the returned next cursor until it is empty.

value.description: claim value as stored JSON text

seq.description: assertions-journal sequence that wrote the claim

claims.description: one page of the lab's claims, newest commit first

next.description: cursor for the next page; empty on the last

capabilities.name: artifacts.classify
capabilities.title: Classify an artifact
capabilities.description: Classify one blob artifact's stored bytes and record a classify.type@1 claim. For artifacts that arrived unclassified or need a refreshed type. Empty primary means nothing was found; no claim is written.

artifactId.description: artifact id in the lab's store

primary.description: primary classify type; empty when the engine found nothing to say

typed.description: whether a classify.type@1 claim was recorded

capabilities.name: artifacts.content
capabilities.title: Read a window of a blob artifact
capabilities.description: Read at most 65536 bytes from a blob artifact. A tree has no single byte stream: read one of its files with artifacts.file.read. A table has none either: use artifacts.rows. Data is base64; offsets are bytes.

artifactId.description: artifact id in the lab's store

capabilities.name: artifacts.file.read
capabilities.title: Read one file of an artifact
capabilities.description: Read one file of a blob or tree artifact by path. Without length the whole file is returned, and one larger than limit is refused. With length, that many bytes (at most 8 MiB) are returned from offset, so a large file is read in pieces until eof. digest and size are always the whole file's.

path.description: file inside a tree; empty for a blob or single-file tree

limit.description: for a whole read: the largest file to return, larger is refused; 0 is 64 MiB

offset.description: for a ranged read: byte offset to start at

length.description: set for a ranged read: bytes to return from offset, at most 8 MiB; the file's size is then no bar

eof.description: the read reached the end of the file

capabilities.name: artifacts.files
capabilities.title: List an artifact's files
capabilities.description: Every file of a blob or tree artifact, with its size, digest and mode, nested trees flattened: with artifacts.file.read, enough to copy the whole artifact out.

path.description: the file's path in the artifact, with nested trees flattened

filePath.description: the file's path inside the root artifact

capabilities.name: artifacts.findings-claims.create
capabilities.title: State a finding
capabilities.description: For the findings subsystem. Not an agent tool.

subject.description: artifact id the finding is about

claims.description: claim kinds (propositions) the finding tracks, e.g. crash.native.observed

candidates.description: candidate claim ids it was promoted from (a tool's own reports)

capabilities.name: artifacts.findings-claims.current
capabilities.title: Current findings
capabilities.description: For the findings subsystem. Not an agent tool.

claims.description: claim kinds (propositions) the finding tracks, e.g. crash.native.observed

candidates.description: candidate claim ids it was promoted from (a tool's own reports)

findings.description: the lab's current findings, newest first

capabilities.name: artifacts.findings-claims.link
capabilities.title: Link a certificate to a finding
capabilities.description: For the findings subsystem. Not an agent tool.

capabilities.name: artifacts.findings-claims.linked
capabilities.title: Certificate to findings links
capabilities.description: For the findings subsystem. Not an agent tool.

linked.description: each linked certificate's artifact id to the findings linked to it

capabilities.name: artifacts.findings-claims.require
capabilities.title: Check a claim is in the lab
capabilities.description: For the findings subsystem. Not an agent tool.

capabilities.name: artifacts.findings-claims.subject
capabilities.title: Resolve a finding subject
capabilities.description: For the findings subsystem. Not an agent tool.

capabilities.name: artifacts.get
capabilities.title: Get an artifact's identity and producer
capabilities.description: One artifact's form, digest, name, size and the capability that produced it, with a reference to its bytes when it is a blob.

activityCode.description: capability that produced the artifact, when known

reference.description: for a blob: a reference to its bytes, readable with artifacts.read

capabilities.name: artifacts.import
capabilities.title: Import files into the lab
capabilities.description: Import files into the lab's artifact store. A path is read on the machine the store runs on: a file becomes a blob artifact, a folder one tree artifact, bytes copied into the lab with their origin recorded. A caller that shares no disk with the store sends bytes instead, as name and data (base64). Each imported file is classified and the result recorded as a classify.type@1 claim; a classification failure never fails the import and is reported per item as classifyError. Paths inside the lab's own data are rejected. The report carries one result per item.

paths.description: absolute paths on the machine the store runs on: a file becomes a blob artifact, a folder one tree artifact; max 64000 per call

path.description: one such path, for a caller with one thing to import

name.description: with data: the file name of bytes sent inline, for a caller that shares no disk with the store

data.description: with name: the bytes to import as one blob artifact, base64

files.description: more files sent inline, each a blob artifact

path.description: the path that was requested, or the name of the bytes that were sent

form.description: content form: blob, tree or table

seq.description: artifacts-journal sequence that wrote the artifact

createdAt.description: artifact creation time, RFC 3339 UTC; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

artifact.description: the artifact the path became; absent when it failed

error.description: why this path was not imported; empty on success

type.description: classify primary type claimed for the artifact; empty when unclassified

classifyError.description: why classifying an imported file failed; the artifact is imported regardless

checkpointError.description: why an enabled host checkpoint could not be recorded; the artifact was still imported

results.description: one result per requested path, in request order

failed.description: how many paths did not import

capabilities.name: artifacts.lineage
capabilities.title: Walk an artifact's lineage
capabilities.description: Lineage of one artifact: ancestors (direction up, default) or descendants (down), with the artifacts, producing activities (including each run's recorded inputs) and derivation edges. Depth bounds the walk; 0 goes to the ends.

depth.description: max derivation depth; 0 walks to the ends

form.description: content form: blob, tree or table

seq.description: artifacts-journal sequence that wrote the artifact

createdAt.description: artifact creation time, RFC 3339 UTC; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

status.description: end status; empty while still running

startedAt.description: activity start time; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

endedAt.description: activity end time; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

seq.description: lineage-journal sequence that wrote the activity

parent.description: parent activity id (a run's session); empty at top level

code.description: code that ran, e.g. apk.search-strings; empty for sessions

role.description: input role in the run, e.g. package

target.description: full input target ref, e.g. artifact:<id> or content:<digest>

artifact.description: input artifact id; empty for content-only targets

inputs.description: the run's recorded inputs, in recorded order; empty for sessions and input-less runs

capabilities.name: artifacts.list
capabilities.title: List the lab's artifacts
capabilities.description: Artifacts in the lab's store, newest commit first: id, name, content digest, form, size and producing activity. One page per call; repeat with the returned next cursor until it is empty. items holds a reference to each blob on the page, for artifacts.read.

type.description: keep only artifacts of this reference type: artifact.blob, artifact.tree or artifact.table

form.description: content form: blob, tree or table

seq.description: artifacts-journal sequence that wrote the artifact

createdAt.description: artifact creation time, RFC 3339 UTC; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

artifacts.description: one page of the lab's artifacts, newest commit first

next.description: cursor for the next page; empty on the last

items.description: a reference to each blob artifact on this page, readable with artifacts.read

capabilities.name: artifacts.overview
capabilities.title: Get the lab's store at a glance
capabilities.description: The lab's store at a glance: artifact count, content items and bytes, activity and claim counts, the store commit sequence and when it last changed.

storeId.description: id of the lab's artifact store

artifacts.description: number of artifact publications (occurrences) in the lab store

contentItems.description: number of content snapshots in the lab store

contentBytes.description: total logical bytes of the lab store's snapshots

activities.description: number of activities (sessions and runs) in the lab store

claims.description: number of claims in the lab store

lastActivityAt.description: when the store last changed, RFC 3339 UTC; empty when it never has

capabilities.name: artifacts.page.detail
capabilities.title: The Artifacts page's view of one artifact
capabilities.description: For the Artifacts page: what it shows, ready to show.

artifactId.description: artifact id in the lab's store

type.description: the artifact's classify type, or its form when it has none

types.description: every classify type claimed for the artifact

producedBy.description: what produced the artifact, in words

relation.description: Made from, for an ancestor; Used to make, for a descendant

noLineage.description: set when the artifact has no recorded lineage

filesNote.description: how many files the tree holds

noPreview.description: why there is nothing to preview

capabilities.name: artifacts.page.list
capabilities.title: The Artifacts page's list
capabilities.description: For the Artifacts page: what it shows, ready to show.

type.description: the artifact's classify type, or its form when it has none

artifacts.description: every artifact in the lab, newest first

capabilities.name: artifacts.read
capabilities.title: Read content by reference
capabilities.description: The read every owner of references has. id is a blob artifact's id, or <artifact id>/<path> for one file of a tree. Returns at most 1 MiB from offset, with the whole content's size and digest. Only content of the call's own lab is found.

capabilities.name: artifacts.rows
capabilities.title: Read a table artifact's rows
capabilities.description: Read at most 1000 rows of a table artifact, in stored order, with its schema (key and columns) and total row count. Offsets are row indexes.

artifactId.description: table artifact id in the lab's store

capabilities.name: artifacts.runs.find
capabilities.title: Find the run a deterministic run would reuse
capabilities.description: For subsystems: before doing the work, ask whether artifacts.runs.record-tree with deterministic would reuse an earlier run for the same code, params and input content. found false means the work must be done. It records nothing. Not an agent tool.

capability.description: capability name the run is recorded under

codeKind.description: what kind of code ran: builtin (the default) for a procedure of the calling subsystem, worker for a worker definition

codeName.description: the code's own name when it is not the capability, such as a worker definition's id

codeVersion.description: code version label, such as a worker definition's digest; 1 when empty

noInputs.description: an acquisition run with no inputs

inputs.description: declared run inputs by role; an empty id is an absent optional input; the first present is the primary

outputName.description: the tree output's name, as artifacts.runs.record-tree would be given it

blobs.description: the blob output names that call would use, so outputs is keyed the same way

reused.description: an identical earlier run's outputs; nothing was written

outputs.description: every output of the run by the name the caller gave it, the tree included

capabilities.name: artifacts.runs.record
capabilities.title: Record a derivation of blobs from an artifact
capabilities.description: For subsystems: record one deterministic derivation (an input blob artifact plus the output bytes computed from it) as a run in the lab, with lineage. An identical earlier run is reused and its bytes returned. Not an agent tool.

code.description: capability name the run is recorded under

version.description: code version label; change it whenever the output could change

suffixes.description: output name suffixes, in order; the first names the run output

outputs.description: computed output bytes per suffix, base64; ignored when an identical run is reused

reused.description: an identical earlier run's outputs were reused

data.description: on reuse, the checked-in output bytes per suffix, base64

capabilities.name: artifacts.runs.record-artifacts
capabilities.title: Record a run with one blob or table output
capabilities.description: For subsystems: record one analysis run over several input artifacts by role, with a blob or table output. A run with inputs is deterministic and reused when identical; one with noInputs is an acquisition and never reused. Not an agent tool.

capability.description: capability name the run is recorded under

codeKind.description: what kind of code ran: builtin (the default) for a procedure of the calling subsystem, worker for a worker definition

codeName.description: the code's own name when it is not the capability, such as a worker definition's id

codeVersion.description: code version label, such as a worker definition's digest; 1 when empty

noInputs.description: an acquisition run with no inputs

inputs.description: declared run inputs by role; an empty id is an absent optional input; the first present is the primary

outputName.description: the one output's name, already derived from the primary input

table.description: the output is a table, not a blob

capabilities.name: artifacts.runs.record-tree
capabilities.title: Record a run whose output is a folder
capabilities.description: For subsystems: record one run over input artifacts whose output is a folder of files, checked in as one tree artifact, with any further blob outputs of the same run. The tree is sent as files, or named as a folder on the machine the store runs on. With deterministic, an identical earlier run is reused and nothing is read or written. Not an agent tool.

capability.description: capability name the run is recorded under

codeKind.description: what kind of code ran: builtin (the default) for a procedure of the calling subsystem, worker for a worker definition

codeName.description: the code's own name when it is not the capability, such as a worker definition's id

codeVersion.description: code version label, such as a worker definition's digest; 1 when empty

noInputs.description: an acquisition run with no inputs

inputs.description: declared run inputs by role; an empty id is an absent optional input; the first present is the primary

deterministic.description: reuse an identical earlier run: same code, params and input content

outputName.description: the tree output's name; a name starting with a dot is appended to the primary input's name

files.description: the tree's files by slash path, base64

dir.description: instead of files: the absolute path, on the machine the store runs on, of a folder whose files are the tree

blobs.description: further blob outputs of the same run by name or .suffix, base64

blobPaths.description: further blob outputs by name or .suffix, each the absolute path of a file on the machine the store runs on

reused.description: an identical earlier run's outputs; nothing was written

outputs.description: every output of the run by the name the caller gave it, the tree included

capabilities.name: artifacts.search
capabilities.title: Search the lab's artifacts
capabilities.description: Search the lab's artifacts: substring text over name, id, digest and tree-entry paths, exact form (blob, tree or table), and primary classify type. Returns one page (newest commit first) with each hit's classify types and what matched, plus the total and form and type facets over the full matched set; repeat with the same filters and the returned next cursor for the following page.

text.description: substring of the artifact name, id, digest or a tree entry path

form.description: content form: blob, tree or table

seq.description: artifacts-journal sequence that wrote the artifact

createdAt.description: artifact creation time, RFC 3339 UTC; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

types.description: classify.type primary types recorded for the artifact

match.description: what matched the text: name, id, digest, or tree:<path>

next.description: cursor for the next page; empty on the last

capabilities.name: artifacts.snapshot
capabilities.title: Snapshot the lab's inventory
capabilities.description: Build an immutable SQLite inventory of the lab at its current store sequence (artifacts, activities, claims, run inputs and tree entries) and publish it as a blob artifact with producer artifacts.snapshot. No run activity is created. Labs over 100000 artifacts or 2000000 tree rows fail instead of copying unbounded.

form.description: content form: blob, tree or table

seq.description: artifacts-journal sequence that wrote the artifact

createdAt.description: artifact creation time, RFC 3339 UTC; empty (journals carry no wall clock)

seq.description: artifacts-journal sequence that wrote the artifact

createdAt.description: artifact creation time, RFC 3339 UTC; empty (journals carry no wall clock)
